beliefs.label: Make Room
beliefs.statement: I make room for people by noticing what they have not said.

receipts.quote: Nico stopped answering during dinner, so I asked if he wanted to leave before the plates came. He nodded and we walked outside.
A new intern kept rereading the same folder. I offered a quieter desk without making her explain.

beliefs.label: Name Need
beliefs.statement: I can name a need before it turns into distance.

receipts.quote: I told Celia I missed our walks before I started resenting her late meetings. We put Thursday on the calendar.
I texted Nico that I needed company after my father's scan, not a distraction. He brought dumplings and sat down.

beliefs.label: Quiet Work
beliefs.statement: Quiet work still counts even when nobody applauds it.

receipts.quote: I spent a morning matching unlabeled photographs to a 1978 neighborhood newsletter. Nobody saw it, but the box finally made sense.
I repaired a torn map with tissue paper for two hours. The next reader could unfold it safely.

beliefs.label: Prepare Hard
beliefs.statement: I prepare a hard conversation on paper before I start it.

receipts.quote: Before telling Nico I felt canceled on, I wrote two sentences in my notebook. At the court I said them without making a case against him.
I drafted what I needed to say to my manager, then crossed out the angry opening. The meeting stayed about the schedule.

beliefs.label: Specific Apology
beliefs.statement: A specific apology means more to me than a grand one.

receipts.quote: Celia apologized for missing soup night and said she should have texted before the pot was on. I believed she understood the part that hurt.
Nico returned my book with coffee on the cover and named exactly what happened. I could let it go.

beliefs.label: Fill Silence
beliefs.statement: I fill silence with details when I am nervous.

receipts.quote: When Celia asked whether I was upset, I explained the whole train delay, the broken kettle, and the weather. I did not answer until the end.
My supervisor asked about a missed deadline, and I listed every archive request from that week. The details came faster than my point.

beliefs.label: Shared Rituals
beliefs.statement: Shared rituals make friendship feel durable.

receipts.quote: Nico and I played basketball every Sunday in February, even when only four people came. The repetition made the winter feel held together.
Celia and I made tomato soup on Friday after a difficult week. Chopping onions beside her steadied me.

beliefs.label: Leave Work
beliefs.statement: I leave work at work when Celia and I cook together.

receipts.quote: A researcher emailed at 6:15, but I closed the archive tab and started soup with Celia. I answered the next morning.
I left a box of photos unprocessed at five because Celia was bringing bread home. We ate before the crust cooled.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I explain the context before I ask for anything.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: A remembered ritual or check-in feels deeply kind.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Tell me the concrete moment and let me respond without rushing.
